verdict.rationale: Bench's only many-items-at-once capability is system-driven: categorization rules generated from business patterns, and smart categorization that handles most transactions automatically. There is no evidence of user-invoked bulk actions, and the API probes found no OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs for scripting bulk work. Missing for 10: user-initiated bulk edit/select/recategorize across transactions or documents, bulk actions via API or agent, documentation of bulk workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
